## Notable fixes

- **Please install this version manually, once.** It is signed with a new update key, so Lattice 0.12.0 and earlier will not update to it automatically: download the DMG below and drag it into Applications over your current copy. Your projects and settings are kept, and later updates are automatic again.
- Lattice opens again on macOS 14, where the PDF preview crashed it on launch.
- Overleaf: your edits no longer stop reaching your local files after the computer sleeps or the network changes.
- Agent panel updated to Synara 1.0.9: /goal posts a visible message, Stop keeps your queued messages with Continue and Edit, and a turn cut off by a restart shows a readable error with Continue task.

## Smaller fixes

- Complete third-party license notices.
